RSBG: in my father's house they would wrap a wick around a nut and light

Rav: molten fat -- a person puts any amount of oil into it and lights
Rav: fish innards that dissolved -- a person puts any amount of oil into them and lights
these [molten fat] are drawn [after the wick] by themselves
these [dissolved fish innards] are drawn [after the wick] by themselves
the Rabbis decreed on molten fat because of unmolten fat
and on dissolved fish innards because of undissolved fish innards
